newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pacific 1996 net down 20.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: First Pacific 1996 net down 20.5 pct.

text.p: Company name First Pacific Co Ltd
NOTE - First Pacific is an investment and management firm. It was included on Hong Kong's blue chip Hang Seng Index with effect from August 30, 1996.

Net is after an exceptional loss of US$92.6 million on reorganisation and rationalisation of subsidiaries and associated companies and provision for investments, and gain of US$76.8 million on dilution and disposal of shareholdings in subsidiaries and associated companies.

The company also announces that its wholly owned subsidiary, First Pacific Capital (1997) Ltd intends to issue in excess of US$250 million of Convertible Bonds, which will be guaranteed by the company. The terms of the Bonds will be determined following a book-building and marketing roadshow. The proceeds of the issue will be used to repay short-term borrowings.
Total dividend for year is 2.71 U.S. cents (including interim dividend of 1.16 cents) vs 2.24 cents.
